title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · MI308X

lede.zh: 本报告汇总 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 在 MI308X 上的固定负载、长上下文、开放环和工具调用轨迹测试。
lede.en: This report summarizes fixed-load, long-context, open-loop, and tool-call trace tests for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on MI308X.

chips: Spec decode off in primary matrix

snapshot.zh: 固定负载 · 4K–256K 输入 · 开放环容量 · BFCL Agent
snapshot.en: Fixed profiles · 4K–256K inputs · open-loop capacity · BFCL Agent

intro.zh: 固定长度、ShareGPT、BFCL 工具调用和长上下文具有不同请求长度与调度行为。页面分别展示，避免合并成通用性能分数。
intro.en: Fixed-length, ShareGPT, BFCL tool calls, and long-context workloads differ in request lengths and scheduling behavior. They are shown separately rather than combined into a general score.

note.zh: 主表是单轮测量；长上下文每点 16 请求。P99 受样本量限制。公开报告省略集群地址、主机名、镜像 digest 和实验路径。
note.en: Primary profiles are single runs; long-context points contain 16 requests. P99 is sample-limited. Cluster addresses, hostnames, image digests, and experiment paths are omitted.

heading.zh: 短输入容量、长输出与自然请求呈现不同服务曲线
heading.en: Short-input capacity, long output, and natural requests produce different serving curves

intro.zh: 8×MI308X、TP4、vLLM ROCm nightly；主表关闭投机解码。固定长度矩阵分别为 128/128 C1、128/2048 C16、512/256 C32；ShareGPT 与 BFCL Agent 是独立工作负载。
intro.en: Eight MI308X accelerators, TP4, vLLM ROCm nightly; speculative decoding is off for the primary matrix. Fixed profiles are 128/128 C1, 128/2048 C16, and 512/256 C32. ShareGPT and BFCL Agent are separate workloads.

notes.zh: Agent 数据来自 BFCL v3 工具调用轨迹，128 请求、并发 8；吞吐不是 Agent 任务成功率。
notes.en: Agent results use BFCL v3 tool-call traces, 128 requests at concurrency 8; throughput is not task success rate.

notes.zh: ShareGPT 与 BFCL Agent 吞吐列在表格中，属于不同请求分布，不与定长点直接比较。
notes.en: ShareGPT and BFCL Agent rates appear in the table and represent distinct request mixes; do not compare them directly with fixed-length points.

title.zh: 主要场景：整体输出吞吐

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

heading.zh: 输入长度扩展到 256K 后，预填充成本成为主要限制
heading.en: At 256K input, prefill cost becomes the dominant constraint

intro.zh: 并发 4、输出 128 tokens、每档 16 请求；TP4。
intro.en: Concurrency 4, 128 output tokens, 16 requests per point; TP4.

notes.zh: 样本量 16，不报告稳健尾延迟结论；TTFT P99 仅列为本轮观测。
notes.en: With 16 samples, no robust tail-latency claim is made; TTFT P99 is reported as an observation from this run.

title.zh: 输入长度与首 token 延迟
title.en: Input length and time to first token

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

heading.zh: 到达率升高时吞吐增加，尾延迟同步拉长
heading.en: Throughput rises with arrival rate while tail latency also grows

intro.zh: 512 输入 / 256 输出的开放环到达测试，每档约 600 请求；各档为独立单次运行。
intro.en: Open-loop arrivals at 512 input / 256 output, about 600 requests per rate; each point is a separate single run.

notes.zh: 原始源数据将 safe_rps 定义为 TTFT P95 不超过 2,000 ms；此页面保留原实验选定的 2.6 req/s 档作为边界示例。
notes.en: The source experiment defines safe_rps as TTFT P95 ≤ 2,000 ms; this page includes the selected 2.6 req/s point as a boundary example.

body.zh: 例如 2.6 req/s 点 600 请求全部成功，TTFT P99 为 1.72 s；2.75 req/s 点全部成功但 TTFT P99 升至 5.40 s。定义阈值需与尾延迟一起看。
body.en: At 2.6 req/s, all 600 requests succeeded with TTFT P99 of 1.72 s; at 2.75 req/s, all succeeded but TTFT P99 rose to 5.40 s. Interpret the rate with the latency threshold.

heading.zh: TP8 提高吞吐并降低 TPOT，容量提升更明显
heading.en: TP8 raises throughput and lowers TPOT, with a larger capacity gain

intro.zh: 同一模型权重在 8×MI308X 上比较 TP4×2 与 TP8×1，均关闭投机解码并保持相同规格与显存利用率。吞吐与 TPOT 按负载类型分别呈现。
intro.en: The same checkpoint was tested on 8× MI308X as TP4×2 and TP8×1, with speculative decoding disabled and the same GPU-memory utilization target. Throughput and TPOT are shown by workload.

title.zh: 同权重 · TP4×2 与 TP8×1 输出吞吐
title.en: Same checkpoint · output throughput at TP4×2 and TP8×1

hint.zh: 不同负载形状分开测量；饱和负载来自独立 open-loop 测试。
hint.en: Workload shapes were measured separately; saturation is an independent open-loop test.

notes.zh: TP8 在六个已测形状的总输出吞吐高约 11%–26%，TPOT 低约 10%–20%；但它使用同样 8 张卡，单卡吞吐效率下降。TP8 的容量优势更大：权重/卡约 64.91 GiB（TP8）对 96.63 GiB（TP4），KV 池约 14.55M 对 2.00M tokens。各 workload 观测样本数和流量形状不同，不能把该表当成统一流量的统计排名。
notes.en: Across six measured shapes, TP8 delivers about 11%–26% more aggregate output throughput and 10%–20% lower TPOT, using the same eight cards and therefore lowering per-card throughput efficiency. Its larger advantage is capacity: about 64.91 GiB weights/card at TP8 versus 96.63 GiB at TP4, with KV pools of about 14.55M versus 2.00M tokens. Sample counts and traffic shapes differ by workload, so this is not a statistical ranking under one uniform traffic profile.

notes.zh: TP8 单副本与 TP4×2 + router 的开放环容量扫描是另一种部署问题；路由与副本数同时变化，且高负载点有显著尾延迟波动，本报告不把该结果用于归因 TP 变化。
notes.en: The open-loop capacity sweep comparing one TP8 replica with TP4×2 plus a router is a separate deployment question. Replica count and routing change together, and high-load tail latency varies substantially; it is not used to attribute effects to TP alone.

methodIntro.zh: 单机 8×MI308X，TP4；使用 ROCm nightly 构建与 vLLM serving benchmark 工具。
methodIntro.en: One system with eight MI308X accelerators, TP4; ROCm nightly build and vLLM serving benchmark tooling.

methodNotes.zh: 投机解码 A/B 和 1M needle 属于单独测试批次，服务参数与主表不同，不能直接叠加解读。
methodNotes.en: Speculative decoding A/B and 1M needle belong to separate batches with different serving parameters and are not combined with the primary matrix.

methodNotes.zh: 公开数据仅保留汇总指标；未包含请求文本或内部主机信息。
methodNotes.en: Only aggregate metrics are published; request text and internal host details are excluded.

methodNotes.zh: TP8/TP4 结果取自独立拓扑测量报告；硬件节点标识、地址与本机路径已省略。拓扑表只保留同权重、投机解码关闭的负载点。
methodNotes.en: TP8/TP4 results come from a separate topology measurement. Host identifiers, addresses, and local paths are omitted. The topology table includes only same-checkpoint points with speculative decoding disabled.
